audience: mobile app developers who build and release apps with Codemagic CI

useCases.title: Check whether the latest build succeeded
useCases.text: The AI lists builds, filtered by app, workflow or branch, and opens one build to read its status. You see what passed or failed and on which branch.

useCases.title: List your apps and their build workflows
useCases.text: The AI lists all apps in the account with their ids, names and workflow ids, and can open a single app. You can see which workflows exist for each app.

useCases.title: Review the build caches of an app
useCases.text: The AI lists the caches of an app with their id, size, last used date and workflow, so you can see which caches are large or unused.

useCases.title: Get or share a download link for a build file
useCases.text: The AI reads a build's artifacts and gets a private download link for a file. It can also create a public, time-limited link that you can share.

useCases.title: Start a build for a branch or tag
useCases.text: The AI starts a build for an app and workflow on the branch or tag you name. You can also pass environment variables, labels and an instance type.

useCases.title: Cancel a running build
useCases.text: The AI finds a running build and cancels it, for example when you pushed the wrong branch or a build is stuck.
